name: Smith Mathiel
summary: In Darnassus, sacred ore is on its way to the forge. After you recover elunite from the shipwreck off Auberdine, Elanaria sends you to Mathiel to have it shaped into a weapon for the Kaldorei.

sections.title: A Sacred Delivery
sections.body: Elanaria sends you across Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace with the elunite ore you recovered from the haunted shipwreck off Auberdine. The warrior trainer packs it in a sturdy case and directs you to Mathiel, one of the capital's finest smiths. He can shape the metal into a weapon worthy of your calling.

sections.title: The Blessing of Elunite
sections.body: Mathiel treats smithing as a craft of devotion. Elunite bears the sacred blessing of Elune, the Moon Goddess, and he accepts the case as an honor. He will shape the holy metal into arms to defend the young boughs of Teldrassil.

faq.answer: Mathiel is a skilled night elf blacksmith who works in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. He makes specialty arms and accepts custom work for the city's defenders.

faq.q: What is special about elunite ore?
faq.answer: Night elves revere elunite as a rare metal blessed by Elune. Mathiel considers shaping it into potent weapons a high honor.
Elanaria, the warrior trainer in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, packs your recovered ore and sends you to Mathiel across the terrace.

faq.q: Is this quest only available to warriors?
aliases: can other classes do smith mathiel
faq.answer: Yes. This is part of the level ten warrior class story, meant to arm young warriors with their first specialized weapon.

faq.q: Where in Darnassus can Mathiel be found?
faq.answer: Mathiel works in Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, just south across the structure from Elanaria.

faq.q: What happens after you deliver the ore to Mathiel?
faq.answer: After you deliver the ore, Mathiel begins shaping it and offers you a choice of which elunite weapon suits your fighting style.

angles.text: As a young Kaldorei warrior, bringing elunite to Mathiel marks a passage from training blades to a custom weapon blessed by the Moon Goddess.
As a night elf, elunite work joins your people's craft with devotion to Elune, where martial strength and faith meet.
As a blacksmith, Mathiel's reverence for elunite shows how Kaldorei smiths bring sacred blessings into their craft alongside heat and hammer.
